name: Unnecessary explanatory copy
summary: Remove helper text that explains familiar fields; keep copy that prevents a real error or consequence.
problem: A sentence under every field, or paragraphs in empty states, pushes content down, trains users to skip text and treats clear labels as insufficient.

bad.description: A form with a long helper paragraph under every field.

good.title: Labels carry the meaning
good.description: Clear labels and familiar fields. Contextual help appears only when a field actually needs it.

good.title: One-line empty state
good.description: A short statement and one action instead of paragraphs explaining the feature.

why: Clear naming, familiar patterns and progressive disclosure make the interface faster. A small learning curve is better than permanent clutter.
exceptions: Copy that prevents a costly error, explains a non-obvious consequence (irreversible deletion, billing), or states a format that cannot be guessed is allowed.
Legal, compliance and first-run onboarding text that is required is allowed.
Error messages are never "unnecessary"; they must explain how to recover.

humanReview: Would a user get stuck without this sentence?
Does the text restate the label?
